summary: Tested VIP 'Show VIP on my main profile' visibility rule end-to-end. Backend: 9/9 pytest cases pass covering vip_only search filtering (visible to VIP viewer, hidden from non-VIP), main-feed is_vip badge hiding for non-VIP viewers, profile view is_vip hiding, owner self-view unaffected, and PUT /api/vip/profile toggle flow (True re-enables discoverability for non-VIP, then restored to False). Frontend: VipEditor on /profile shows vip-show-on-main-row INSIDE vip-publish-box with the exact note text 'Off: no one can see your VIP status, except VIP members — they can still find you as VIP in search.' and switch unchecked. Browse page: Lena card has VIP badge + red border for VIP admin viewer, and only a Premium badge (no VIP) for plain non-VIP premium viewer. Lena's vip.show_on_main restored to False at test suite end.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py list_profiles (~1681) correctly adds {'vip.show_on_main': {'$ne': False}} to vip_only filter only when viewer is not VIP — matches spec.
server.py list_profiles main-feed loop (~1757) sets is_vip=False for non-VIP viewers when show_on_main is off — spec compliant.
server.py get_profile (~1886) hides is_vip for non-VIP viewers (owner & VIP viewers unaffected) — correct.
VipEditor.jsx: vip-show-on-main-row is nested inside vip-publish-box with correct i18n key vip_show_on_main_off matching the required note text.
